title: 第1章 开宗立派系统第2章 冥婚
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
“求你了，拜我为师吧！”
“我可以帮你洗一个月的袜子，这一个月的肉也都让给你吃！求你了！”
“别逼我跪下来求你……”
寂月穿着一身洗得发白的粗布麻衣，正厚颜无耻地抱着自家小妹的大腿，苦苦哀求。
小妹寂琳一脸嫌弃的看着比自己大十岁的姐姐。
“姐，你又在发什么疯？我还得去喂猪，真的没空跟你闹了。”
“不要不要，你先答应我拜我为师，要不然我就不让你走！”寂月为了让对方拜自己为师，简直脸都不要了。
寂琳实在是没办法，只得敷衍道：“好好好，师父姐姐，你行行好，我再不去喂猪，猪要被饿死了。”
听到脑海里出现“叮”的一声机械音后，寂月傻乐地站直了身。
“嘿嘿，小妹你最好了，我就知道你最爱姐了！以后你就是我徒弟，姐罩着你！”
寂琳翻了个白眼，手里提着猪食去了猪圈。
这里是玄元大陆，是一个修仙世界。
寂月是一个月前穿到这里的，穿之前是个被癌症折磨的病患，现在的身份是寂家的傻子大女儿。
穿过来的时候，附带了个开宗立派系统。
任务也简单，开设宗门，广收徒弟。
但她是个没有灵根的废物。
其实也算不上废物，因为这片大陆普通人最次也是个五行杂灵根，她居然没有灵根！
说出去这怕是得被人研究研究。
而系统发布的第一个任务就是收徒，只需要一位徒弟就行。

任务奖励可以抽取灵根，开启她的修行之旅。
系统检测一番过后，最终把目标放在了寂家的小女儿身上。
寂琳，单系水灵根，资质上乘。
对于收徒，系统也是有标准的，不收废物。
但什么是废物，系统说了算。
原主的小妹，今年才六岁。
对于寂月说的话，寂琳纯粹是用哄小孩的态度回应。
毕竟自家大姐痴傻十六年了，说出什么话也不奇怪。
“系统，等我洗个手，待会再抽奖。”
寂月赶紧去河边，蹲下身子开始搓洗双手，两只手都快洗得发红，这才停了下来。
她其实还想供三支香的，但是寂家这条件，想想还是算了。
“系统，抽奖！”
眼前出现一个四四方方的面板，看起来很有科技感，画面中出现抽奖二字，寂月伸手点了下去。
随后，心跳如雷，像是等待着死神的判刑般，紧张得快要喘不过气来。

"Please, worship me as your teacher!"
"I can wash your socks for a month and give you all the meat for this month! Please!"
"Don't force me to kneel down and beg you..."
Jiyue was wearing coarse linen clothes that had been washed white, and she was brazenly hugging her little sister's thigh and begging.
The younger sister Ji Lin looked at her sister who was ten years older than her with a look of disgust.
"Sister, what are you crazy about? I have to feed the pigs, so I really don't have time to make trouble with you."
"No, no, you promise me to become my master first, otherwise I won't let you go!" Ji Yue was so shameless in order to make the other party worship her as her master.
Ji Lin really had no choice but to say perfunctorily: "Okay, okay, master sister, please do your best. If I don't feed the pigs, the pigs will starve to death."
After hearing a mechanical "ding" sound in her mind, Jiyue stood up straight in a silly mood.
"Hey, little sister, you are the best. I know you love sister the most! From now on, you will be my apprentice, and sister will protect you!"
Ji Lin rolled her eyes and went to the pig pen with pig food in her hand.
This is Xuanyuan Continent, a world of immortal cultivation.
Ji Yue came here a month ago. Before she was a patient suffering from cancer, her current identity is the idiot eldest daughter of the Ji family.
When it came through, it came with a system for establishing a sect.
The task is also simple, open a sect and recruit many disciples.
But she is a waste without spiritual roots.
In fact, she is not considered a waste, because ordinary people in this continent have five elements of mixed spiritual roots at the end, and she actually has no spiritual roots!
If I tell you this, I'm afraid it will have to be studied by others.
The first task released by the system is to recruit apprentices, and only one apprentice is needed.
The mission reward can extract spiritual roots and start her spiritual journey.
After some system testing, the target was finally placed on the Ji family’s youngest daughter.
Ji Lin has a single line of water spirit roots and has excellent qualifications.
The system also has standards for accepting apprentices and does not accept waste.
But what is waste, the system has the final say.
The original owner's little sister is only six years old this year.
Regarding what Jiyue said, Jilin responded purely with the attitude of coaxing a child.
After all, my eldest sister has been stupid for sixteen years, so it’s not surprising what she said.
"System, let me wash my hands and draw the lottery later."
Jiyue hurried to the river, squatted down and started to wash her hands. Both hands were almost red from washing, and then she stopped.
She actually wanted to offer three sticks of incense, but after thinking about the Ji family's conditions, she decided not to do it.
"System, lottery!"
A boxy panel appeared in front of her. It looked very technological. The word "Lottery" appeared on the screen. Jiyue reached out and clicked on it.
Then, my heart beat like thunder, as if I was waiting for the sentence of death, and I was so nervous that I almost couldn't breathe.
